result.summary: The image shows an urban residential intersection with continuous sidewalks but minimal pedestrian protection. Crossing distances are significant across the wide roadway, and existing crosswalk markings are faded and incomplete.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk on the side street is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection across the side street

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked pedestrian crossing across the main thoroughfare in the foreground, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked wide road.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked vehicles extend close to the intersection corner, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the intersection corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide but aging sidewalks and a lack of formal crossing infrastructure at the visible junction. While traffic calming is indicated by signage, the presence of blank walls, vacant lots, and poor pavement quality detracts from the overall safety and comfort of the streetscape.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The lack of painted crosswalks at the junction fails to clearly communicate pedestrian priority to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The road surface is heavily cracked and degraded, which can cause tripping hazards and affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb and the building corner on the left may block visibility between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left building corner and right-side parking

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corner to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair damaged sidewalk sections to provide a safe and accessible walking surface.

result.summary: This residential intersection features narrow sidewalks and extremely faded crosswalk markings, providing minimal protection for pedestrians. The lack of visible traffic control devices and the presence of utility poles obstructing the walkway further degrade the safety of the environment.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are nearly invisible, failing to alert drivers to the presence of a pedestrian crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs at the corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: On the right side of the image along the sidewalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install standardized curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, unmarked roadway and a long stretch of chain-link fencing, creating a sterile and potentially high-speed corridor. Faded crosswalk markings and a lack of physical traffic calming or pedestrian-scale lighting further reduce the safety and comfort of the walking environment.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are severely degraded, making them nearly invisible to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide asphalt surface encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the perceived crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The extensive chain-link fence creates a monotonous environment with no active surveillance or physical buffer for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness and clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the crossing point to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Plant street trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic and improve the streetscape aesthetics.
